title: Early open facing a blind 3-bet
keyIdea: You'll have position against the blinds, so you can call a bit wider than vs a 3-bet from behind.

actions.call: QQ-77, AKo, AQs-ATs, KQs-KJs, QJs, JTs, AQo

notes.A5s: A classic bluff raise: the ace blocks AA/AK, and it can still make a straight or the nut flush.
